exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: attendance.exclude_without_wifi_or_gps: exclude log data when neither Wi-Fi nor GPS permits attendance checking

inputBoundary: Two explicit source-aligned booleans state whether Wi-Fi and GPS, respectively, permit attendance checking for the log-data scope.
outputBoundary: Exclude the log-data scope only when neither Wi-Fi nor GPS permits attendance checking; retain when either or both permit it.
limitations: This binding does not infer whether raw Wi-Fi or GPS observations are present or usable.
This binding does not build or match the classroom Wi-Fi fingerprint database.
This binding does not derive building entry, exit, or boundary crossing from GPS observations.
This binding does not select which retained evidence source takes precedence or execute the source Wi-Fi-to-GPS fallback.
This binding does not join retained log data to a class schedule or infer attendance.
A missing Wi-Fi or GPS permit-attendance-check value fails closed rather than being interpreted as false.
